edges: Marc 'Blackie' DuQuesne kidnaps Dick Seaton's fiancée, Dorothy Vaneman.
Seaton is married to Dorothy Vaneman.
DuQuesne uses Seaton's plans to kidnap Dorothy Vaneman.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: DuQuesne conspires to sabotage Seaton's spaceship.
Dick Seaton is pitted against Marc 'Blackie' DuQuesne.
DuQuesne plans to build his own spaceship.
The Skylark of Space features Dick Seaton as the idealistic protagonist.
